Claim amendment · #35631 · 2026-11-20T07:51Z

File surface (amended): adds, as PR #35774 carries them at `e5a7e08b`:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/celAuthoring.ts` — the lazy engine seam (`inferFormulaReturnDeclaration`); a static import would put cel-js in the main bundle and bypass the test seam (os-dev-report 7032209353).
- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` (`returnType` JSDoc and `.describe()` prose only) and the regenerated `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx`, `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`, `content/docs/references/system/migration.mdx` — the shipped text said a declared `currency` survives a `number` verdict, which this card's ruling makes false.
- `packages/formula/src/formula-return.ts` and `packages/formula/src/formula-return.test.ts` — the lane's ruling A on the dev's round-1 open question: `inferFormulaReturn` answers unproven (`{}`), not `number`, for a numeric expression that reads a money-typed operand it cannot prove, so `number` means "proven not money" before the inspector withdraws a declared `currency` (os-dev-report 7033149333).
Changeset: `@objectstack/formula` patch and `@objectstack/spec` patch join the app-shell entry. Overlap re-run after this amendment.
